recent_actions.Title: Trump says Pulte can declassify ‘whatever’ he wants, sparking fears of exposing intelligence secrets

recent_actions.Title: US Navy seeks to boost production of new anti-radar missile

recent_actions.Action: The US withdrew most forces from Nigeria after a joint operation killed ISIS's second-in-command, now providing intelligence support.
recent_actions.Title: US withdrew forces from Nigeria after operation against ISIS, AFRICOM chief says

recent_actions.Action: Japan, Italy, and the UK awarded a £4.6 billion development contract for the GCAP sixth-generation fighter jet.
recent_actions.Title: Multibillion-dollar contract secures ‘major step forward’ for GCAP fighter jet

recent_actions.Action: Poland teamed with Spain to double its purchase of Airbus A330 MRTT tanker aircraft to four units.
recent_actions.Title: Poland teams up with Spain to double tanker aircraft purchase

recent_actions.Action: European NATO allies have largely filled the gaps left by US reductions in the NATO Force Model.
recent_actions.Title: Europeans to fill almost all gaps left by US in NATO defense plans, source says

recent_actions.Action: Katalyst Space's LINK spacecraft launched to reboost NASA's Swift observatory, which is experiencing orbital decay.
recent_actions.Title: Katalyst’s LINK On Its Way to Reboost Swift

recent_actions.Action: ULA launched an Atlas V with Amazon Leo satellites, marking the final Atlas V launch except for Starliner missions.
recent_actions.Title: Atlas V Launches More Amazon Leos with Only Six Starliner Flights Left on the Books

recent_actions.Action: NASA awarded $600 million in CLPS contracts for robotic lunar landers and is considering sending a Mars rover model to the Moon.
recent_actions.Title: NASA Awards More CLPS Contracts, May Send Mars Rover Engineering Model to the Moon

recent_actions.Action: NASA's Aerospace Safety Advisory Panel and GAO raised concerns about the future of the International Space Station and commercial replacements.
recent_actions.Title: ASAP Worries About ISS, GAO Wonders What Comes Next

recent_actions.Action: The EU Satellite Center signed the CISE Cooperation Agreement to strengthen Europe's maritime security and domain awareness.
recent_actions.Title: The European Union Satellite Center Signs ‘CISE’ Agreement to Strengthen Europe’s Maritime Security

recent_actions.Action: A SpaceX Falcon 9 launched semiconductor fabrication test beds for Besxar Space Industries on a sub-orbital flight.
recent_actions.Title: Semiconductor manufacturing test bed flies alongside Starlink satellites on Falcon 9 launch

recent_actions.Action: NASA astronauts successfully replaced a broken robot arm joint on the International Space Station during an EVA.
recent_actions.Title: Astronauts ‘operate’ on space station’s broken robot arm

recent_actions.Action: Blue Origin outlined its plan for resuming New Glenn rocket pad operations after a recent explosion.
recent_actions.Title: Blue Origin outlines return to flight logistics for its New Glenn rockets

recent_actions.Action: South Korea unveiled a sweeping AI and semiconductor investment drive, with Samsung planning $260B for new fabs.
recent_actions.Title: Chip Industry Week In Review

recent_actions.Action: McCormick received a $28M tariff refund, but the Iran war is driving up inflation and logistics costs.
recent_actions.Title: McCormick gets $28M tariff refund as Iran war raises costs

recent_actions.Action: South Carolina Ports will temporarily pause container operations at its Leatherman Terminal due to tempered volumes and cost control.
recent_actions.Title: South Carolina Ports closing terminal temporarily to rein in costs

recent_actions.Action: Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing is set to visit Laos, driving a wedge into ASEAN after denying access to Aung San Suu Kyi.
recent_actions.Title: With Laos Trip, Min Aung Hlaing Drives a Wedge Into ASEAN

recent_actions.Actor: Indonesian military, West Papua National Liberation Army (TPNPB), US (Nicholas F. Gosselin)
recent_actions.Action: The Indonesian military recovered the body of an American pilot killed by Papuan separatists.
recent_actions.Location: Yahukimo regency, Highland Papua province, Indonesia
recent_actions.Title: Indonesia Recovers Body of American Pilot Killed by Papuan Separatists

recent_actions.Action: The Myanmar government plans to revive the controversial China-backed Myitsone dam project.
recent_actions.Title: Myanmar to Push Ahead With Suspended Myitsone Dam Project, Officials Say

recent_actions.Action: Ukrainian strikes are causing damage to Russian oil production, while Russia launched a mass attack on Kyiv.
recent_actions.Title: Barring a counter to oil damage, Russian economy seen in crisis

recent_actions.Title: China’s truck drone launcher hides airpower in civilian traffic
